# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 1.1.x   | Yes |
| 1.0.x   | Best-effort (rebranded to DonutMail) |

Supported Minecraft targets for 1.1.x: Paper 26.1.2–26.3 (Java 25). Folia through 26.2.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security problems.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability) on this repository (Security → Report a vulnerability).

Include:

- Affected version and server software (Paper/Folia + MC version)
- Steps to reproduce
- Impact (item duplication, unauthorized mail send, data loss, etc.)

Do not publish exploit details until maintainers have had a reasonable chance to investigate and ship a fix.
